$comment: Mirror of ROADMAP.md with acceptance criteria. Agents may only change 'passes', and only after make check passed. Jakub adds and edits items. 'pr' lists open pull requests working on the item (2026-11-07).

features.title: Walls and standard roofs
acceptance: Rectangle and regular polygon entry, typed coordinates and wall lengths
Gable, hip, half-hip, shed and pyramid roofs match DACAD's fixtures (crates/tectora-core/tests/dacad_cases.rs)

features.title: Roof definition per wall
acceptance: Eave or gable, pitch, eave height, overhang, Kruppelwalm, pitch breaks, priority, clad gable, material and direction markers per wall
Results equal DACAD for the fixture cases

features.title: Dormers, chimneys, roof windows, openings
acceptance: Dormer kinds gable, pointed, hip, half-hip, shed, trapezoid, round
Area deductions and abutment lines as DACAD (cases C24-C36)

features.title: Calculation helpers and round roof
acceptance: Pitch / eave height / overhang / wall position by triangle, two parallels, point in space, merge faces
Hip/valley pitches, build-up thickness, Runddach

features.title: Flat roof, hand-drawn roof lines and faces
acceptance: Flat roof as DACAD (cases FD1, FD2)
Manual lines and faces count in the quantities

features.title: Move, rotate, mirror, copy parts; parallel wall shift
acceptance: Same edit operation from the editor and the MCP tool

features.title: Views and material results
acceptance: Front, back, side and top views
Area by material and material names

features.title: MCP server and CLI with parity
acceptance: An MCP tool for every editor operation, each write with a summary
tectora calc gives the same result as the app

features.title: Job files and bundles
acceptance: Attached drawings and photos
Export and import .tectorajob with project, files, history and preview

features.title: Stored result
acceptance: The offer's figures are kept with the engine version
App and MCP show any later difference

features.title: Versioned file format
acceptance: docs/tectora.schema.json matches the model (tests/schema.rs)
Older versions migrate on load; newer files are refused

features.title: Open jobs by double-click on macOS and Windows
acceptance: .tectora and .tectorajob file associations in the installers

features.title: Post-processing: trapezoid split, sheet layout, rafters
acceptance: Trapezzerlegung, Bahnenteilung, Rollbahnenteilung and Sparreneingabe match DACAD on fixture cases
Each has an MCP tool

features.title: Help points and lines, extra text, separating lines, dormer in plan, covering direction
acceptance: Hilfspunkte, Hilfslinien, Zusatztext, Trennlinien, Gaube im Grundriss and Deckrichtung as in DACAD
Each has an MCP tool

features.title: Job variants, DXF import/export, printed views and lists
acceptance: Variants of one job
DXF round trip
Printable views and lists

features.title: AI builds the roof from technical drawings
acceptance: An inbox folder turns each drawing set into a draft job
The AI's steps show live in the app with Accept / Revert
Measured on a test set of real drawings with DACAD's roofs: share of roofs the AI gets right
The AI marks what it was unsure of; the colleague confirms before the job leaves draft

features.title: Signed releases with in-app updates
acceptance: Tagged builds are signed for macOS and Windows
The app offers and installs an update

features.title: Library of past roofs
acceptance: Search, filters and details
New job from a past roof

features.title: Edit roof objects directly in the plan and the 3D view
acceptance: Dormers, chimneys, windows selectable and editable in plan and 3D
Roof windows stand out in 3D

features.title: E2E tests for every button and flow
acceptance: A Playwright suite under app/e2e covers every control
make e2e runs it

features.title: Warning when walls in line are merged and a pitch is lost
acceptance: A localized warning names the walls

features.title: Show how every roof area and line was calculated
acceptance: Breakdown per face and line in the results, same numbers in CLI, MCP and UI
